title: Phone close-up whip tour with tagline swap
summary: One phone on a bright two-tone gradient: it rises in, then the camera punches, tilts and whips across its home screen in tight close-ups. It ends wide with a tagline the phone itself wipes into the call to action.
use_when: A mobile app with one strong home screen worth touring up close
Silent social autoplay where motion, not VO, carries the energy
A short app teaser that ends on a tagline plus a try-it line
Brands with a loud single accent colour that can fill the background

look.type_style: rounded geometric sans, medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking, cap height ~6 % H, one line left of or right of the phone

sfx.event: fast punch-in or whip across the screen with motion blur
camera lands on a close-up after a whip
spin into the hard cut at 12.17 s
phone sweeps across the tagline and swaps it to the CTA

structure.shot: empty lime-to-white vertical gradient; one phone (home screen) rises from below to centre, ~38 % of frame height wide-shot, then holds
structure.camera: static frame; phone travels, ~1 % scale creep during the hold (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: phone y from below frame to centre 0.25 to 1.00 s, springs.heavy ~22 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); hold 30 fr

structure.shot: punch from the wide phone to a tilted close-up of the screen header: greeting line, three action pills, account chip
structure.camera: zoom-tier full to detail in ~8 fr (2.00 to 2.27 s, ±0.25 s), phone rolled ~-12 deg and leaned back in 3D; then slow push-in ~1.00 to 1.08 over 30 fr
structure.motion: zoom easings.inExpo into springs.cameraIn landing ~2.50 s (overshoot not measurable), motion blur on the punch frames

structure.shot: same header close-up; the phone rolls through upright to a lean the other way, then straightens and recedes a little
structure.camera: tilt-plane: roll ~-12 deg to ~+8 deg 3.25 to 4.00 s with blur, hold lean to 4.77 s, straighten by 5.27 s; pull-out ~1.10 to 1.00 over 5.00 to 6.00 s
structure.motion: roll on easings.inOutCubic ~22 fr (±0.25 s); straighten springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s); motion blur only on the roll frames

structure.shot: vertical whip: the close-up phone drops out of the bottom, frame is empty gradient for one cell, then the phone re-enters from the top, heavily blurred
structure.camera: whip-pan vertical ~460 px/s at 1920 (motion.json t=6), ~15 px/fr; content moves down, wraps once
structure.motion: easings.inExpo out 8 fr, easings.outExpo in 8 fr (±0.25 s); vertical motion blur

structure.shot: medium shot of the upper half of the phone: header, pills, balance card with a 4-digit amount, add-currency tile
structure.camera: pull-out ~1.08 to 1.00 over 7.00 to 8.00 s, then hold with ~1 % drift
structure.motion: landing springs.cameraOut ~24 fr (±0.25 s); the phone is upright, centred

structure.shot: punch-in on the balance card: currency flag, account digits and the amount fill the frame
structure.camera: zoom-tier region to element, ~1.00 to 1.6 in ~8 fr (9.00 to 9.27 s, ±0.25 s), then slow push-in ~38 %/s decaying to 10.00 s

structure.shot: lateral whip right: phone slides to the right half, close-up of greeting line, pills and balance card
structure.camera: whip-pan right ~450 px/s at 1920 (motion.json t=10), blur 10.27 to 10.50 s; settle 10.77 s; then push-in ~1.00 to 1.05
structure.motion: easings.inOutCubic ~15 fr (±0.25 s) with horizontal motion blur, settle springs.ui

structure.shot: the phone rolls hard and the camera dives into the currency flag; extreme blurred detail
structure.camera: speed-ramp roll ~+20 deg plus push-in to detail tier, accelerating into the cut
structure.motion: easings.inExpo ~12 fr (±0.25 s), strong rotational motion blur

structure.shot: the phone arrives upside down and spinning, rolls to a diagonal close-up of the transactions block, then near upright on the right of frame
structure.camera: roll ~180 deg to ~-30 deg to ~-3 deg 12.17 to 13.00 s; then static close-up with ~1 % drift
structure.motion: roll easings.outExpo ~25 fr (±0.25 s), motion blur on the first ~8 fr

structure.shot: lateral shift left reveals the full transaction row with the credited amount and running balance
structure.camera: dolly left ~1/3 frame width in ~8 fr (14.00 to 14.27 s, ±0.25 s), then hold
structure.motion: easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s), horizontal blur on 14.00 s cell

structure.shot: the close-up phone flies up out of frame; empty gradient; a 4-word tagline reveals left of centre while a small phone rises in from the lower right and yaws to face camera
structure.camera: static wide; phone exit up ~420 px/s at 1920 (motion.json t=15)
structure.motion: phone exit easings.inExpo 16 fr (15.03 to 15.57 s from cuts.json); tagline word-reveal left to right 15.57 to 16.50 s, ~7 fr per word (±0.25 s); small phone y from below plus yaw ~25 deg to ~10 deg, springs.heavy ~30 fr, settled 16.77 s; hold to 18.00 s

structure.shot: the phone slides from right to left across the tagline; behind it the line becomes a 3-word try-it line with the product name
structure.motion: phone x right third to left third ~30 fr, easings.inOutCubic (±0.25 s); text swap masked by the phone's edge (mask-wipe), settled 19.00 s

structure.shot: end hold: phone on the left third, try-it line on the right

params.brand: brand.json: accent fills the top of the background gradient, bg/white the bottom; display font for the two lines
params.content.screen: one tall home screen (rebuilt UI or a screenshot) with a header, action pills, a balance card and a list
params.content.focus: 3-4 rects on the screen for the close-ups (header, card, list row, detail)
params.content.tagline: one line, ~4 words, shown next to the phone
params.content.cta: one line, ~3 words, includes the product name
params.aspect: 16:9 by default; 9:16 stacks the line above the phone

notes: Studied from 4 fps sheets (0.25 s resolution); no 30 fps strips, so all frame counts below 8 fr, springs and overshoot are suggested defaults. Pan speeds come from motion.json. Single shot from 0 to 12.17 s, one real hard cut at 12.17 s (spin into spin), one soft transition 15.03 to 15.57 s (phone flies up out of frame). Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Catalogue hints said data-stats and chart-draw: no chart is drawn; family is mobile-app. Proposed terms (not used as ids): device-wipe, whip-wrap.
